title: Add ShoppingListFiles.shoppingListsURL(in:) helper
description: Add a static method shoppingListsURL(in:) to ShoppingListFiles.swift that returns folderURL.appendingPathComponent('shopping-lists', isDirectory: true) and auto-creates that directory via FileManager if absent. Swallows creation errors silently — callers handle downstream read/write failures via existing error paths. Security-scoped access is bracketed on the parent folderURL.
acceptance_criteria: shoppingListsURL(in:) returns <folderURL>/shopping-lists/ as a directory URL
Directory is created with withIntermediateDirectories:true when absent
Method returns the URL even when creation fails; no error is thrown or propagated
A second invocation when the directory already exists is idempotent (no error)

handoff_summary.completed: Added `static func shoppingListsURL(in folderURL: URL) -> URL` to `ShoppingListFiles.swift`. Returns `<folderURL>/shopping-lists/`, creates directory idempotently, swallows creation errors, brackets security-scoped access on parent URL.
handoff_summary.remaining: None for this bead. Downstream beads can now call `ShoppingListFiles.shoppingListsURL(in:)` when scoping file I/O to the subfolder.
handoff_summary.risks: None. Change is additive — no existing callers modified. The security-scoped bracket follows the same pattern used by `discover(in:)`, `readText(from:)`, and `writeText(_:to:)`.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent for unit test coverage of the new helper.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No conflict risk. No existing methods or call sites were modified.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Followed the exact security-scoped access pattern already used by `discover(in:)` — `startAccessingSecurityScopedResource` on `folderURL` with a `defer` guard. Used `try?` on `createDirectory` to silently swallow errors per spec. `withIntermediateDirectories: true` makes repeated calls idempotent.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Method should be tested for: (1) returns correct URL path component, (2) creates directory when absent, (3) is idempotent on second call, (4) returns URL even when creation fails.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Security-scoped access bracket is on the parent `folderURL`. If `folderURL` itself is not a security-scoped bookmark URL the bracket is a no-op (which matches the behaviour of all other helpers in this file).

conflict_risks: No conflict risk. No existing methods or call sites were modified.

execution_history.summary: Added `ShoppingListFiles.shoppingListsURL(in:)` static method to ShoppingListFiles.swift. It brackets security-scoped access on the parent `folderURL`, appends the `shopping-lists` path component as a directory URL, attempts directory creation with `withIntermediateDirectories: true` (errors swallowed via `try?`), and always returns the computed URL regardless of creation outcome. File passes `swiftc -typecheck` with no errors.
